summary.zh: 本页把西班牙成年职业联赛金字塔、U19/U16 青年联赛金字塔，以及本站已建档、曾进入这些层级的中国球员样本放在同一套口径里。西甲俱乐部青训合同不等于西甲出场；签职业合同也不等于已经踢过对应联赛。
summary.en: This page places Spain's senior professional pyramid, the U19/U16 youth pyramid, and documented Chinese samples into one scope. An academy deal with a La Liga club is not a La Liga appearance, and a professional contract is not automatically a match record.

scope_note.zh: 这是研究样本索引，不是西班牙足协或西甲官方全量名单。球员可同时出现在多个层级；当前注册以球员主档为准。吕孟洋当前注册是西班牙人青年B队，2026-09-20 的客场进球记在球员页，不是一线队或成年 B 队出场。
scope_note.en: This is a research sample index, not an official RFEF or LaLiga census. A player may appear on more than one layer. Current registration still follows the player record. Lyu Mengyang's current club is Espanyol Juvenil B; his 20 September 2026 away goal is on his player page and is not a first-team or senior-reserve appearance.

detail.zh: 职业运动员劳动合同，通常对应一线队或职业编制注册，可参加成年职业联赛。
detail.en: A professional employment contract, usually tied to first-team or senior professional registration.

detail.zh: 梯队培训协议 / ficha juvenil。未满 18 岁的非欧盟球员通常只能签这一类，不能自动升成一线队职业合同。
detail.en: An academy training agreement / youth licence. Non-EU minors are usually limited to this type and it does not become a first-team professional deal by itself.

detail.zh: 能确认俱乐部或竞赛层级，但公开来源还不足以判断是职业合同还是青训协议。
detail.en: The club or competition layer is known, but public sources are not yet enough to classify the contract.

name.zh: 成年职业与半职业联赛

summary.zh: 西甲和西乙由西甲联盟运营，是仅有的两级完全职业联赛。西协甲及以下由西班牙足协体系组织；B 队通常从西协甲打起，不能与一线队同组。2021 年改制前的西乙B仍是当时第三级，西丙是当时第四级，这两级单独成层，不并进现在的西协甲或西协丙。
summary.en: LaLiga and Segunda are the only fully professional national tiers, run by LaLiga. Primera Federación and below sit in the RFEF system. Reserve teams usually enter at Primera Federación and cannot share a group with their first team. Before the 2021 reform, Segunda División B was the third tier and Tercera División the fourth; those historical tiers stay separate from today's Primera Federación and Tercera Federación.

stable_structure.zh: 西班牙顶级职业联赛，20 队。只有一线队职业合同且完成联赛注册，才可能获得西甲正式出场。
stable_structure.en: Spain's top professional league, 20 clubs. Competitive appearances require a first-team professional registration.

stable_structure.zh: 第二级完全职业联赛。降级的西甲一线队仍踢这里，例如武磊随西班牙人征战的升级赛季。
stable_structure.en: The second fully professional tier. Relegated LaLiga first teams compete here, including Wu Lei's Espanyol promotion season.

stable_structure.zh: 第三级。包含独立俱乐部和西甲/西乙俱乐部的 B 队。李昊外租科尔内利亚、杜月徵的马贝拉、何小珂的萨瓦德尔一线队都落在这一层。
stable_structure.en: The third tier, mixing independent clubs and reserve teams of LaLiga/Segunda clubs. Li Hao's Cornellà loan, Du Yuezheng at Marbella and He Xiaoke's Sabadell first-team minutes sit here.

stable_structure.zh: 2021 年改制前的第三级全国联赛，不是现在的西协甲。林良铭的皇马卡斯蒂亚 2016/17 和阿尔梅里亚 B 队 2018/19 落在这一层。
stable_structure.en: Spain's third national tier before the 2021 reform, not today's Primera Federación. Lin Liangming's Real Madrid Castilla spell in 2016/17 and his Almería B season in 2018/19 sit here.

stable_structure.zh: 第四级全国联赛。邝兆镭 2025 年加盟莱里达竞技一线队属于这一层；签约与随队训练不等于已经取得正式出场。
stable_structure.en: The fourth national tier. Kuang Zhaolei's 2025 move to Atlètic Lleida belongs here; signing and training do not prove a competitive appearance.

stable_structure.zh: 2021 年改制前的第四级。林良铭 2017/18 的阿尔梅里亚 B 队、徐天沅 2016/17 的巴列卡诺 B 队都在这一层，不能写成现在的第五级西协丙。
stable_structure.en: The fourth tier before the 2021 reform. Lin Liangming's 2017/18 Almería B season and Xu Tianyuan's 2016/17 Rayo Vallecano B registration sit here, not in today's fifth-tier Tercera Federación.

stable_structure.zh: 第五级。杨希离开西班牙人后的奥斯皮塔莱特、肖远豪的蒙塔涅萨一线队都按这一层记录。
stable_structure.en: The fifth tier. Yang Xi's L'Hospitalet spell after Espanyol and Xiao Yuanhao's Montañesa first-team minutes are recorded here.

stable_structure.zh: 第六级及以下由各自治区足协组织，例如加泰罗尼亚甲级、乙级。肖远豪的图罗佩拉和国际巴塞罗那落在这里，不能写成全国职业联赛。
stable_structure.en: Tier 6 and below are run by regional federations, such as Catalonia's senior divisions. Xiao Yuanhao's Turó Peira and Inter Barcelona spells belong here, not in the national professional pyramid.

summary.zh: 西甲俱乐部的 Juvenil A 通常打全国最高级荣誉联赛，Juvenil B 打全国联赛，Juvenil C 多在自治区联赛。A/B/C 不是同一竞赛层级。
summary.en: A La Liga club's Juvenil A side usually plays División de Honor, Juvenil B plays Liga Nacional, and Juvenil C is mostly regional. A, B and C are not the same competition level.

name.zh: U19 荣誉联赛 División de Honor Juvenil

stable_structure.zh: 西班牙 U19 最高级别全国联赛，对应多数西甲俱乐部的 Juvenil A。能分开写场次的已建档样本是杨希、林良铭、徐天沅、何小珂、韩丰璘、王皓文和陈雨晟。Patrick海外君的编译表另列 24 个名字，总数没有逐人闭合。
stable_structure.en: Spain's top national U19 league, usually Juvenil A at La Liga clubs. The placed samples with separable appearance counts are Yang Xi, Lin Liangming, Xu Tianyuan, He Xiaoke, Han Fenglin, Wang Haowen and Chen Yusheng. A Patrick Haiwaijun compilation lists 24 names whose totals are not closed player by player.

name.zh: U19 全国联赛 Liga Nacional Juvenil

stable_structure.zh: U19 第二级全国联赛，对应多数俱乐部的 Juvenil B。2026/27 第 7 组里，吕孟洋在西班牙人青年 B，汪修昊在萨瓦德尔青年 B。黄子杰有欧罗巴青年 A 的注册报道，同期竞赛名单还没有他的出场。这一层不是荣誉联赛。
stable_structure.en: The second national U19 tier, usually Juvenil B. In 2026/27 Group 7, Lyu Mengyang is at Espanyol Juvenil B and Wang Xiuhao at Sabadell Juvenil B. Huang Zijie has a reported Europa Juvenil A registration, but the contemporaneous squad sheet does not list an appearance. This is not División de Honor.

stable_structure.zh: 第三级及以下青年联赛，含加泰 Preferent Juvenils。吕孟洋 2025/26 欧罗巴 Juvenil B、汪修昊 2025/26 达姆 Juvenil C、黄子杰 2025/26 欧罗巴 Juvenil B，以及刘凯源 2026/27 比利亚雷亚尔 Juvenil C 观察名单，都先归这一层。
stable_structure.en: Third-tier and regional youth leagues, including Catalonia's Preferent Juvenils. Lyu Mengyang's 2025/26 Europa Juvenil B, Wang Xiuhao's 2025/26 Damm Juvenil C, Huang Zijie's 2025/26 Europa Juvenil B, and Liu Kaiyuan's 2026/27 Villarreal Juvenil C watch list sit here.

name.zh: U16 / Cadete 与更低年龄段

summary.zh: Cadete 没有全国统一职业联赛，最高组多为自治区荣誉联赛。达姆、科尔内利亚、比利亚雷亚尔 Cadete A 都按这一层理解。
summary.en: Cadete football has no single national professional league; the top group is usually a regional honour division. Damm, Cornellà and Villarreal Cadete A are read at this layer.

name.zh: U16 荣誉联赛 Cadete Honor

stable_structure.zh: 各自治区 U16 最高组。刘凯源 2025/26 比利亚雷亚尔 Cadete A、邝兆镭达姆 U16A、吕孟洋科尔内利亚 Cadet A 都按这一层记录。
stable_structure.en: The top regional U16 group. Liu Kaiyuan's 2025/26 Villarreal Cadete A, Kuang Zhaolei's Damm U16A and Lyu Mengyang's Cornellà Cadet A are recorded here.

name.zh: 其他 Cadete / Infantil 青年组

stable_structure.zh: 非最高组的 U16 或 U14 注册，例如吕孟洋奥斯皮塔莱特 Cadet B、张林峒圣胡斯特 U14A、李东宸奥斯皮塔莱特 U14A。
stable_structure.en: Non-top U16 or U14 registrations, such as Lyu Mengyang at L'Hospitalet Cadet B, Zhang Lindong at Sant Just U14A and Li Dongchen at L'Hospitalet U14A.

name.zh: 已确认俱乐部青训，联赛层级待拆
name.en: Confirmed academy link, league layer pending

stable_structure.zh: 能确认在西班牙俱乐部梯队，但公开来源还没有稳定拆到具体青年联赛层级。达姆、卡拉万切尔、马竞青训起步阶段常用这一层，避免把俱乐部名字写成西甲出场。
stable_structure.en: The Spanish academy link is confirmed, but the exact youth league layer is not yet stable. Damm, Carabanchel and early Atlético academy stages use this bucket so a club name is not written as a La Liga appearance.

note.zh: 2019 年加盟西班牙人一线队，本库西甲+西乙合计 103 场。这是职业一线队合同，不是青训。
note.en: Joined Espanyol's first team in 2019. The repository records 103 combined LaLiga and Segunda appearances. This is a professional first-team contract, not an academy deal.

note.zh: 西班牙人降级后，武磊续约并随一线队征战西乙升级赛季。
note.en: After relegation, Wu Lei renewed and played the Segunda promotion season with the first team.

note.zh: 北京国安租借至巴列卡诺一线队。西甲正式出场 1 场约 9 分钟，属于职业租借而非青训。
note.en: Loaned from Beijing Guoan to Rayo Vallecano's first team. One LaLiga appearance of about nine minutes; a professional loan, not academy football.

note.zh: 新华社确认 2023 年与马竞签职业合同后外租科尔内利亚。竞赛落点是西协甲，不是西甲或西乙出场。
note.en: Xinhua confirms a 2023 Atlético professional contract and a loan to Cornellà. The competitive layer is Primera Federación, not LaLiga or Segunda.

note.zh: 2016 年起在马竞青训。青训阶段不能写成西甲出场；2023 年职业合同是另一节点。
note.en: Atlético academy from 2016. The academy years are not LaLiga appearances; the 2023 professional contract is a separate node.

note.zh: 西协甲马贝拉 22 场 3 球。这是第三级成年职业路径，不是西乙。
note.en: 22 appearances and 3 goals for Marbella in Primera Federación. This is a third-tier senior path, not Segunda.

note.zh: 2022-12-18 对奥萨苏纳 B 替补登场，是可核西协甲首秀。本库不把它写成西乙。
note.en: Came on against Osasuna B on 2022-12-18, a verified Primera Federación debut. The repository does not record this as Segunda.

note.zh: 离开西班牙人后自由转会奥斯皮塔莱特。足协报名可核注册，公开统计未见正式出场。
note.en: Joined L'Hospitalet after Espanyol. CFA lists confirm the registration; public stats show no competitive appearance.

note.zh: 蒙塔涅萨一线队西协丙：3 次名单、1 次替补共 2 分钟。
note.en: Montañesa first team in Tercera Federación: three match-day squads and one substitute appearance of two minutes.

note.zh: 加泰甲图罗佩拉约 10 场，加泰乙国际巴塞罗那 3 次首发 2 球。国际巴塞罗那与巴萨、国米无关。
note.en: About 10 games for Turó Peira in Catalonia's top regional senior league, then three starts and two goals for Inter Barcelona in the second regional tier. Inter Barcelona is unrelated to FC Barcelona or Inter Milan.

note.zh: 2025-07-28 加盟西协乙莱里达竞技一线队，合同公开口径至 2027 年。已完成签约，成年正式出场仍待回填。
note.en: Joined Atlètic Lleida's first team on 2025-07-28, publicly contracted to 2027. The signing is confirmed; senior competitive appearances are still pending.

note.zh: 晚年进入西班牙低级别职业俱乐部体系。本库明确：不能把签约自动等同于西乙出场。
note.en: Entered Spanish lower-division clubs late in his career. The repository is explicit: a signing is not a Segunda appearance.

note.zh: 2016/17 皇马卡斯蒂亚，当时的第三级西乙B：7 场 0 球。2016-08-20 对皇家社会 B 队完成首秀并助攻。不是西甲，也不是现在的西协甲。
note.en: Real Madrid Castilla in 2016/17, then third-tier Segunda División B: 7 appearances and no goals. He debuted on 2016-08-20 against Real Sociedad B and assisted. This is not LaLiga and not today's Primera Federación.

note.zh: 2018/19 从皇马租借到阿尔梅里亚 B 队，西乙B（当时第三级）28 场 4 球。这是第三级进球，不是西甲或西乙一线队。
note.en: Loaned from Real Madrid to Almería B in 2018/19. Segunda División B, then the third tier: 28 appearances and 4 goals. These are third-tier goals, not LaLiga or Segunda first-team goals.

note.zh: 同一租借的前一个赛季先踢改制前西丙（当时第四级）：联赛 32 场 8 球，升级附加赛 4 场 0 球。这 8 球不能写成第三级。
note.en: The previous season of the same loan was the old Tercera División, then the fourth tier: 32 league appearances and 8 goals, plus 4 promotion-playoff appearances and no goals. Those 8 goals are not third-tier goals.

note.zh: 2016 年 7 月巴列卡诺官网把他列入从青年队升入 B 队的名单。2016/17 B 队在改制前西丙第 7 组（当时第四级）。注册可核，正式出场次数尚未回填，不能写成 0 场，也不是西甲。
note.en: Rayo's site listed him in July 2016 among players promoted from the youth team to the B team. In 2016/17 that side played old Tercera División Group 7, then the fourth tier. Registration is verified; competitive appearances are not yet filled in, so this is not a confirmed zero and not LaLiga.

note.zh: 公开百科记其荣誉联赛首秀为 2022-03-20，2022/23 约 24 场。本人采访也提到踢过荣耀联赛后超龄离队。本库球员主档尚未拆 A/B，故标 mixed-source。
note.en: Public encyclopaedia notes a División de Honor debut on 2022-03-20 and about 24 games in 2022/23. His own interview also says he aged out of that league. The player master record has not yet split A/B, so this stays mixed-source.

note.zh: 公开口径 2021/22 主踢西班牙人 U19B 全国联赛约 23 场，同年开始上 A 队。不是只在 U19A。
note.en: Public sources put about 23 Liga Nacional games for Espanyol U19B in 2021/22, with the same season's first A-team minutes. He was not exclusively U19A.

note.zh: 2015/16 皇马青年 A 队，U19 荣誉联赛第 5 组。MARCA 2015-10-26 写他对阿尔卡拉、普埃布拉各进 2 球。BeSoccer 阅读口径是 4 球，西语维基俱乐部表写 17 场 5 球。场次记为 4–17、进球记为 4–5，范围表示还没闭合。
note.en: Real Madrid Juvenil A in 2015/16, División de Honor Group 5. MARCA on 2015-10-26 records two goals against Alcalá and two against Puebla. BeSoccer reads four goals, and the Spanish Wikipedia club line says 17 games and 5 goals. Appearances stay 4–17 and goals 4–5; the range is not a closed total.

note.zh: 2015/16 巴列卡诺青年 A 队，U19 荣誉联赛第 5 组，与皇马青年队同组。2015-09-06 客场对阿尔卡拉首发，约第 65 分钟被换下。场次记为「1 起」，进球未见；赛季总数还没闭合。
note.en: Rayo Vallecano Juvenil A in 2015/16, División de Honor Group 5, the same group as Real Madrid. He started away at Alcalá on 2015-09-06 and was substituted around the 65th minute. Appearances stay 1 起 and no goal is recorded; the season total is not closed.

note.zh: 2021/22、2022/23 代表萨瓦德尔青年 A 队打 U19 荣誉联赛第 3 组。2022-11-06 客场对西班牙人、2023-03-20 主场再对西班牙人，两次与杨希的比赛均有首发报道。媒体约 37 场、约 7 球还没对上足协技术表，所以都带「约」。这不是后来西协甲的 1 场。
note.en: Sabadell Juvenil A in 2021/22 and 2022/23, División de Honor Group 3. Match reports have him starting against Espanyol on 2022-11-06 and again on 2023-03-20, both opposite Yang Xi. A media total of about 37 games and about 7 goals is not a federation sheet, so both figures stay approximate. This is not his later Primera Federación appearance.

note.zh: 2022/23 马贝拉青年 A 队，U19 荣誉联赛第 4 组。2022-11-06 对韦尔瓦第 81 分钟替补；2022-11-19 对休达 Polillas 首次首发并打满全场。公开报道写到当天已出场 8 次、其中 1 次首发，赛季未完，记为「8 起」。进球未见。
note.en: Marbella Juvenil A in 2022/23, División de Honor Group 4. He came on in the 81st minute against Recreativo on 2022-11-06, then started and played the full match against Polillas Ceuta on 2022-11-19. Reports through that date say 8 appearances and 1 start, so the count stays 8 起. No goal total is recorded.

note.zh: 2024/25 巴达洛纳青年 A 队，U19 荣誉联赛第 3 组。2025-05-06 赛季总结写 13 次出场、4 次首发，场均约 41 分钟，场次按这个总结闭合。进球未见。总数不是足协逐场技术表。球队随后降入全国二级。
note.en: Badalona Juvenil A in 2024/25, División de Honor Group 3. A 2025-05-06 season summary records 13 appearances and 4 starts, about 41 minutes per game, so the appearance count is closed. No goal total is recorded. The total is not a federation match sheet. The team then dropped to Liga Nacional.

note.zh: 2025/26 帕塔科纳青年 A 队，U19 荣誉联赛第 7 组。公开口径写联赛 29 场、27 次首发、约 2265 分钟，并任队长之一。进球未见。2026 年 6 月俱乐部宣布他升入一线队；一线队自治区联赛出场另计。场次尚未对上足协单场技术表。
note.en: Patacona Juvenil A in 2025/26, División de Honor Group 7. Public reports put him at 29 league appearances, 27 starts and about 2,265 minutes, and name him as one of the captains. No goal total is recorded. The club announced his promotion to the first team in June 2026; first-team regional appearances stay separate. The count is not yet tied to a federation match sheet.

note.zh: 西班牙人 2026-09-15 官宣加入青年 B 队，打 U19 全国二级。2026-09-20 客场 3-1 圣库加特，下半场替补打入该队正式比赛首球。FutbolBase 截至 2026-10-17 可见 5 场 1 球，赛季未结束，场次和进球都记为下沿。这是青训协议，不是荣誉联赛，也不是一线队。
note.en: Espanyol announced his Juvenil B move on 2026-09-15, in the second national U19 tier. On 2026-09-20 he came off the bench and scored in a 3-1 away win at Sant Cugat. FutbolBase shows 5 appearances and 1 goal through 2026-10-17; the season is open, so both figures stay floors. This is a youth agreement, not División de Honor and not the first team.

note.zh: FCF / FutbolBase 可核 2025/26 Preferent Juvenils 约 29 场 6 球。这是加泰 U19 次高组，不是全国荣誉联赛。
note.en: FCF / FutbolBase confirm about 29 appearances and 6 goals in 2025/26 Preferent Juvenils. That is Catalonia's second U19 group, not the national honour league.

note.zh: 2026-09-02 公开球队页列入 Juvenil C，但个人页仍显示暂无 2026/27 ficha。只作名单观察，不是已完成竞赛注册。
note.en: A 2026-09-02 public squad page lists him in Juvenil C, but his personal page still shows no 2026/27 licence. This is a squad observation, not completed competition registration.

note.zh: 2025/26 Cadete A：30 场、1355 分钟、4 球、20 次首发。俱乐部 2026-06-04 官宣续约，仍是青训体系。
note.en: 2025/26 Cadete A: 30 appearances, 1,355 minutes, 4 goals and 20 starts. Villarreal renewed him on 2026-06-04; he remains in the academy.

note.zh: FutbolBase：科尔内利亚 Cadet A，Divisió d'Honor 6 场 0 球。
note.en: FutbolBase: Cornellà Cadet A, six appearances and no goals in the honour division.

note.zh: 2024 年 10 月代表达姆 U16A 在加泰 U16 荣誉联赛对赫罗纳 U16A 进球。

summary.zh: 中国 U17 亚洲杯终报名 23 人里有 3 人注册在西班牙：谢晋（皇家卡拉万切尔）、汪修昊（达姆）和门将 Zhu Yuxuan（赫塔菲）。10 月 28 日公布的世少赛 25 人集训名单里没有任何西班牙注册球员，4 名海外球员来自塞尔维亚、克罗地亚和韩国。中国世少赛首战的对手正是西班牙（11 月 20 日）。
summary.en: Three of China's 23 at the AFC U17 Asian Cup were registered in Spain: Xie Jin (Real Carabanchel), Wang Xiuhao (Damm) and goalkeeper Zhu Yuxuan (Getafe). The 25-player World Cup camp list of 28 October has no Spain-registered player; its four overseas players are in Serbia, Croatia and Korea. China's first World Cup opponent is Spain, on 20 November.
